The function is `itertools.combinations`, and the sentinel form of `iter` takes two arguments.

```json
{"facts": {"function": "combinations", "arguments": "2"}}
```

`itertools.combinations(iterable, r)` returns r-length subsequences of the input. The sentinel form is `iter(object, sentinel)`: it calls `object` repeatedly and stops when the result equals `sentinel`, so it takes two arguments (the callable and the sentinel).
